name: @spike/agent-pack
description: A SYNTHETIC EXTENSION contributing an `agents` fragment — the platform's own forcing-function for an extension shipping its own OOTB agent. A @spike/* package so the CI `--filter='!@spike/*'` excludes it; a workspace member only so pnpm links @rayspec/platform (the extension ENTRY imports defineExtension from it). NOT the shape a real extension ships in: `workspace:*` resolves only inside this workspace, so copied out this manifest installs nowhere — see examples/stream-backend/README.md ('Shipping this extension from its own repo') for the out-of-repo form, which pins the released versions instead. NO turbo build/typecheck/test task; the extension carries its own build step instead (../../build.mjs + tsconfig.build.json) because loadExtensions loads compiled JavaScript only at deploy time, and a test loads this .ts source through the loader's explicit typeStrippingImporter seam.
